install.command: pip install --target pack --no-deps cadquery==2.8.0 cadquery-ocp==7.9.3.1.1 ezdxf==1.4.5 multimethod==1.12 nlopt==2.11.0 runtype==0.5.3 casadi==3.8.2 pyparsing==3.3.3 scipy==1.18.1 numba==0.68.1 llvmlite==0.50.0 vtk==9.6.2 numpy==2.5.5 typing_extensions==4.16.0
install.download_rate_note: ~2.4 MB/s on this network; not a clean-room measurement

notes: trame and matplotlib are not imported by import cadquery and can be omitted for a headless pack.
vtk is imported by cadquery.occ_impl.shapes and is required for STL tessellation; it cannot be omitted in CQ 2.8.
casadi is imported by cadquery.assembly -> solver at top level; a lazy-import patch would be required to omit it.
numba/llvmlite are not imported for this bracket; removing them leaves basic import/compile working, but they are declared dependencies and may be needed by NURBS/vis paths.
